Historical original-sample note, superseded for timing coverage by the 28 October full remeasurement: Collection stopped under the response-status safeguard: HTTP 429 received from https://syndication.twitter.com; collection halted. No omitted attempt was counted as a website failure.
Recovery robots parsing processed the HTML fallback and retained any valid directives. No intentional crawler ban or site outage is inferred from the earlier strict-format rejection.

The separate normal-browser follow-up rendered all three declared pages. Width and initial Tab-path captures do not establish full keyboard navigation, responsive usability or complete-process accessibility.
Published procedural statements describe observed website content; legal accuracy, current fees, downloadable-file validity and transaction success were not independently certified.

Historical original-sample note, superseded for timing coverage by the 28 October full remeasurement: Completion review 2026-10-26 of the 21 October follow-up: 7 previously unmeasured criteria resolved, adding 10 assessed budget points. 3/3 additional core-page follow-ups were representative; excluded captures and original attempts are retained. Prior valid timing samples are unchanged. 38 criteria remain unmeasured; see the completion record for required evidence.

Supplementary GET search tasks, where present, use observed search forms and do not expand the original Lighthouse timing sample. Retained visual comparison is explicitly distinguished from fresh capture. Collector connection failures, robots exclusions and incomplete responses are never website zeros.

28 October full remeasurement completed the entire 18-run performance sample; the main timing table and performance rows now use that separate Chrome 156 campaign. Historical timings and earlier failures remain retained in labSourceReplacement and private artifacts. This resolves performance sampling only, not all criteria.

Coverage revision 2026-10-28: 8 further criteria resolved using explicit reviewed evidence. Restricted, untested and monitoring-dependent criteria remain unmeasured. Scores and measurement coverage are different quantities; no conversion of missing evidence to passes or zeros.

categories.label: External Security Posture and Technical Privacy

rows.label: HTTPS enforced
rows.reason: The declared HTTP entry upgraded to trusted HTTPS without an observed downgrade. Credit is limited to this captured entry chain.

rows.label: Valid TLS certificate
rows.reason: Hostname/date/chain-verified HTTPS succeeded with the separately root-verified public intermediates supplied to the recovery Node process. Default Node chain construction failed on some hosts; this is not evidence of complete server-delivered chains or universal client compatibility. See the recovery amendment.

rows.label: Modern TLS configuration
rows.reason: Insufficient verified evidence for the complete criterion: Full protocol/cipher assessment, not one negotiated connection. Untested steps and constrained observations remain unmeasured, not passed or failed.

rows.label: HSTS present and meaningful
rows.reason: Captured HSTS policies were parsed against the frozen rule: full requires max-age at least one year with includeSubDomains; a valid positive narrower policy earns half; absent, disabled or malformed earns zero. Worst declared page governs.

rows.label: Content-Security-Policy present and meaningful
rows.reason: Reviewed both the header and meta policies together. default-src * with unsafe-inline in the header and wildcard/unsafe-inline/unsafe-eval script sources plus wildcard object sources in the meta policy remain permissive even when intersected. The policy does not meet the frozen meaningful script/object restriction rule. No exploit was attempted.

rows.label: Other important security headers
rows.reason: Reviewed nosniff, DENY/SAMEORIGIN or restrictive frame-ancestors, and explicit meaningful Referrer-Policy values. Full needs all three protections, half some, zero none; worst sampled page governs.

rows.label: Secure cookie configuration
rows.reason: Only attributes of observed cookies are reviewed. Full requires Secure, HttpOnly and explicit Lax/Strict on all; partial means mixed protections. No names/values or complete consent/tracking audit are published.

rows.label: No mixed HTTP/HTTPS content
rows.reason: Insufficient verified evidence for the complete criterion: Browser and sampled-page evidence. Untested steps and constrained observations remain unmeasured, not passed or failed.

rows.label: No unnecessary software/version exposure
rows.reason: Reviewed the captured response Server/X-Powered-By fields and generator metadata on all three representative core documents. No software product/version disclosure was established in this specific header/metadata sample. Full criterion credit is sample-bounded and does not assert a modern, patched or vulnerability-free stack.

rows.label: No obvious sensitive configuration exposure
rows.reason: Insufficient verified evidence for the complete criterion: Passive eligible-page review only; no guessed sensitive paths. Untested steps and constrained observations remain unmeasured, not passed or failed.

rows.label: Third-party tracking and technical privacy restraint
rows.reason: Insufficient verified evidence for the complete criterion: Request inventory plus tracking classification. Untested steps and constrained observations remain unmeasured, not passed or failed.

rows.reason: The observed GET search endpoint returned HTTP 500 with ministry branding and an explicit application-error message for the benign ministry keyword. This agrees with the retained earlier search failure. The two rejected POSTs target Google analytics collection, not a search API; no first-party search request was rejected by the collector. Zero is limited to this verified query failure, not all site availability. Generic Web Page Blocked responses elsewhere were excluded from scoring.

labSourceReplacement.previousConditions: Sequential Lighthouse 13.5.0 / Chrome 153 laboratory runs, up to three declared attempts per each of 3 predeclared pages on mobile and desktop; default simulated throttling and fresh browser processes. Per-pair successful-run counts and any unattempted runs are explicit; a collection stop is not a website failure. Operator network/geography unverified. Guarded DOM/axe observations use GET/HEAD and four-request concurrency; excluded requests can change rendering. No forms submitted, physical devices, field INP, full security audit, complete service process or 28-day reliability claim. Independent review pending. Different page samples are not a national comparison.
labSourceReplacement.reason: A separate, fully declared 18-run campaign completed all three original pages and both device profiles. The historical single successful main-sample run and all earlier stopped attempts are retained, not merged or selectively retried.
